test_get_ffmpeg_filters: test that get_ffmpeg_filters returns over 100 available FFmpeg filter names
test_ffmpeg_utils_common_filters: test that common filters like aresample and scale are in the filter list
run_get_ffmpeg_filters: run get_ffmpeg_filters to retrieve a list of all available FFmpeg filter names
run_get_ffmpeg_versions: run get_ffmpeg_versions to retrieve a dict mapping FFmpeg library names to version tuples
run_set_ffmpeg_log_level: run set_ffmpeg_log_level to configure FFmpeg verbosity from quiet to trace
